# Vault Structure

- `Home/` — the house, its utilities, its insurance and its paperwork
- `Personal/` — people, vehicles, health, career
- `Tech/` — servers, services and the network
- `Finance/` — accounts and recurring spend
- `Reports/` — generated series, excluded from search
- `Workflows/` — automation notes, excluded from search
- `Inbox/` — anything not yet filed
